name: Publicly reachable AI service has a direct path to confirmed sensitive data
description: Detects when publicly reachable AI service has a direct path to confirmed sensitive data using only declared evidence.
securityIntent: Prevent the risk condition described by AGCF-XSP-001.
remediationIntent: Correct the provider configuration or relationship and reassess with complete, fresh evidence.
